full_name: Mary C. Brinton | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Social Sciences Hrdy Fellow Harvard University
bio: Mary C. Brinton is the Reischauer Institute Professor of Sociology at Harvard University. Her research focuses on gender inequality, labor-market change, and young adulthood in East Asia, especially Japan.
